UPDATE tutorial_evaluations SET 
  organizacao = CASE WHEN organizacao = 0.8 THEN 0.75 WHEN organizacao = 0.3 THEN 0.25 ELSE organizacao END,
  cooperacao  = CASE WHEN cooperacao  = 0.8 THEN 0.75 WHEN cooperacao  = 0.3 THEN 0.25 ELSE cooperacao  END,
  conteudo    = CASE WHEN conteudo    = 0.8 THEN 0.75 WHEN conteudo    = 0.3 THEN 0.25 ELSE conteudo    END,
  objetivo    = CASE WHEN objetivo    = 0.8 THEN 0.75 WHEN objetivo    = 0.3 THEN 0.25 ELSE objetivo    END,
  metas       = CASE WHEN metas       = 0.8 THEN 0.75 WHEN metas       = 0.3 THEN 0.25 ELSE metas       END
WHERE organizacao IN (0.8, 0.3) OR cooperacao IN (0.8, 0.3) OR conteudo IN (0.8, 0.3) OR objetivo IN (0.8, 0.3) OR metas IN (0.8, 0.3);
